support_claim: No proposition establishes identity or distinctness between crm:NBA-102 and billing:Northbridge Analytics Inc., and multiple propositions explicitly preserve the relation as unresolved.

propositions.proposition: CRM record NBA-102 lists the account name as "Northbridge Analytics".
propositions.relevance: Grounds the left referent crm:NBA-102 to the name form "Northbridge Analytics", which differs from the billing name "Northbridge Analytics Inc."

propositions.proposition: Billing invoices record the billed name as "Northbridge Analytics Inc."
propositions.relevance: Grounds the right referent billing:Northbridge Analytics Inc. to the legal-name form used in billing documents.

propositions.proposition: Sales uses the short name "Northbridge Analytics" while billing and the MSA use "Northbridge Analytics Inc."
propositions.relevance: Documents coexisting name variants for the same commercial relationship without evidence that crm:NBA-102 and the billing legal name denote the same registry entity.

propositions.proposition: A 2024 credit check returned a Wyoming LLC named "Northbridge Analytics LLC".
propositions.relevance: Introduces an additional live registry candidate, preserving multiple possible legal entities beyond the two referents under judgment.

propositions.proposition: Legal has not determined which registry entity is the contracting party.
propositions.relevance: Explicitly states that identity between commercial referents and a definitive legal/registry entity has not been established.

propositions.proposition: The packet instructs to treat the registry link as unresolved.
propositions.relevance: Directly preserves the identity relation between crm:NBA-102 and billing:Northbridge Analytics Inc. as open rather than closable to SAME_ENTITY or DISTINCT.
